claims.text: Cushing disease: medical tx for persistent disease, recurrence, or as a bridge to definitive tx;
claims.quote: In Cushing disease, medical treatment is used for persistent disease, recurrence, or as a bridge to definitive treatment.
Pituitary-directed therapy includes dopamine agonists (such as cabergoline) and somatostatin analogues (such as pasireotide).

claims.text: adrenal steroidogenesis inhibitors: metyrapone, mitotane, levoketoconazole, osilodrostat, etomidate;
claims.quote: Adrenal steroidogenesis inhibitors include metyrapone, mitotane, levoketoconazole, osilodrostat, and etomidate.

claims.text: GC receptor blocker mifepristone: approved for Cushing syndrome w hyperglycemia.
claims.quote: The glucocorticoid receptor blocker mifepristone is approved for use in Cushing syndrome with hyperglycemia.
